instruction:
Compare four World Development Indicators metadata entries: NY.GDP.MKTP.KD, NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG, NY.GDP.DEFL.KD.ZG and FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG. For each open the rendered metadata page and report its current displayed name, unit, frequency, reference period, aggregation method and source organization, together with the central definition. Follow the World Bank explanations of current versus constant prices and aggregate growth rates. Determine which entry answers each question: the level of price-adjusted total output, annual real-output growth, broad economy-wide price change, and changes in a consumer basket. Explain why the two inflation measures and the GDP level/growth entries cannot be substituted for one another, and identify one limitation stated in the GDP metadata. For a fictional constant-price GDP series of 200, 210 and 231 in three consecutive years, calculate the two annual growth rates and the total two-year percentage change; distinguish that result from adding the annual percentages. Do not retrieve country datasets, use a raw endpoint or download a file.

Stopping condition: Stop when four cited metadata records, the four-question measure mapping, compatibility/limitation explanation and correctly distinguished annual and cumulative growth calculations are reported.

Constraints:
- Only use the browser actions available to you. Do not open API endpoints, raw data files, view-source pages or downloads, and do not use external programs.
- Do not sign in or create accounts. Do not provide anyone's private personal information; use only task-supplied fictional values if an interaction requests personal details.
- Remain read-only: do not purchase, reserve, apply, post, send messages, contact people or change external records.
- Navigation, search, filtering, sorting and read-only form or calculator interactions are allowed.
- Do not bypass authentication, paywalls, CAPTCHAs or access challenges. Dismiss optional prompts without creating an account or supplying personal information.
- Support the answer with observed page evidence and source URLs. For values that can change, report what the site shows during the run. Preserve the requested dates, units and scope; report unavailable information explicitly instead of inventing it.

items.criterion: Map indicators to the four questions
items.description: Determine which entry answers each question: level of price-adjusted total output (NY.GDP.MKTP.KD), annual real-output growth (NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG), broad economy-wide price change (NY.GDP.DEFL.KD.ZG), and changes in a consumer basket (FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG). Full credit for correctly mapping all four. Partial credit for correctly mapping some but not all.

Explain why the two inflation measures and the GDP level/growth entries cannot be substituted for one another. Full credit for clearly distinguishing GDP-deflator versus consumer-basket inflation and GDP level versus GDP growth, using the World Bank explanations of current versus constant prices and aggregate growth rates.

items.criterion: Identify one limitation in GDP metadata
items.description: Identify at least one limitation explicitly stated in the GDP metadata provided by the World Bank. Full credit for accurately quoting or summarizing a limitation found on the GDP metadata page. Full credit if the site is inaccessible and the agent clearly reports this limitation of access.

items.criterion: Calculate annual and cumulative growth rates correctly
items.description: Calculate the annual growth rates (5% and 10%) and the total two-year percentage change (15.5%) for the series 200, 210, 231. Distinguish the correct cumulative result (15.5%) from simply adding the annual percentages (15%). Full credit for correct calculations and distinction. Partial credit for partial correctness in calculations.

Agent must not retrieve country datasets, use raw API endpoints, download files, view source pages, or use external programs. Full credit if none of the forbidden actions are taken. Deduct points if any constraint is violated.
